The tires appear to be from a commercial or bulk seller rather than a private individual.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'IKWE ANTHONY' is visible across all images.

risks.risk: The tires may be mismatched or include damaged/repaired units.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the tread wear indicators (TWI) on the sidewall.
Photo of the manufacture date (DOT code) on the sidewall.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
